The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S04|Johto League Champions]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Single releases== ===DVD=== Johto League Champions was first released in single-disc DVD sets released between 2002-2004 by [[VIZ Media|Viz Video]] and distributed by {{wp|Pioneer Entertainment}} (now known as {{wp|NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan}}) and Ventura Distribution, containing all 52 episodes across them all. Each volume has one disc with seven episodes, except the seventh volume which has ten episodes on one disc. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Johto}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Johto}}" ! ''[[EP209|Machoke, Machoke Man!]]'' | style="background:#FFF; {{roundybr|5px}}" | February 10, 2004 |} ===VHS=== "High Voltage Collection" Johto League Champions single VHS releases were released in 2002-2004 by [[VIZ Media|Viz Video]] and distributed by {{wp|Pioneer Entertainment}} (now known as {{wp|NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan}}) and Ventura Distribution. Each volume contains three select episodes from various points in the season, rather than sequential episodes. Altogether, 27 of the season's 52 episodes were released across the nine volumes. The volume numbers of these VHS releases are a continuation of ''[[List of English language The Johto Journeys home video releases (Region 1)|The Johto Journeys]]'' VHS and DVD volumes (skipping Volume 52, which was presumably reserved for the last two episodes of ''The Johto Journeys'', which were never released on individual volumes). Two episodes are mistitled on the back of the VHS covers: ''[[EP181|A Ghost of a Chance]]'' is listed as ''The Tower Inferno'', and ''[[EP178|The Grass Route]]'' is listed as ''The Grass Root''. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Johto}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Johto}}" |- ! This [[Complete Collection]] contains six discs with 52 episodes across them combined (although the cover incorrectly states that there are five discs). Its catalogue number is 3000067603. This release consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.
